candidate_relations.reason: Bednar tumor is a melanocytic-pigmented variant of DFSP, whereas the lesion shows hemosiderin deposition, adipose entrapment, and melanocytic marker negativity characteristic of HFLT.
Although DFSP can be CD34 positive, the hemosiderin-rich fibrolipomatous morphology and inflammatory infiltrate support HFLT rather than DFSP.
Hemosiderotic fibrohistiocytic lipoma is an older name for hemosiderotic fibrolipomatous tumor and matches the clinical, morphologic, and immunophenotypic findings.
Nodular pseudolipomatous fat necrosis is a different reactive process and does not represent the CD34-positive hemosiderotic fibrolipomatous tumor described.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Reactive fat-necrosis lesion rather than HFLT
